name: Descendent of Pentival
notes: Decided 2026-10-27: one level, rare. Dragon trinkets and the Dragon Lord set bonuses scale by the passive's per-stack amount times the stacks, on top of the trinkets mod's NG+ scaling. Tested (Dragon Heart): plan-generosity 20261027-020522.
summary: Each stack of Pelor's Blessing also increase the effects of Dragon trinkets by the same amount. This includes set bonuses.
